searchText: It was bugging me that there was no Official ™️ description of how network upgrades are activated now that we've gone from blocks, to TTD, and epochs/timestamps combos.... not to mention launching the beacon chain and hard forking it once before the merge too! So, I drafted an informational EIP to describe the evolution over time: https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-6953 Would love feedback from client devs, spec maintainers, etc. 🙂

excerpts.author: timbeiko
excerpts.content:
It was bugging me that there was no Official ™️  description of how network upgrades are activated now that we've gone from blocks, to TTD, and epochs/timestamps combos.... not to mention launching the beacon chain and hard forking it once before the merge too!

So, I drafted an informational EIP to describe the evolution over time: https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-6953 

Would love feedback from client devs, spec maintainers, etc. 🙂
